d: Spiky, short crimson hair with jagged bangs frames a youthful face with sharp, narrow gold eyes. The lean, athletic build is dressed in a yellow undershirt beneath an open black hooded jacket, paired with olive-drab cargo pants featuring black straps, tactical pouches, a grey knee pad, and black lace-up boots. A black mechanical prosthetic arm with glowing yellow circular accents replaces the right limb.
